name: Ben Holmes
bio: Ben is a Lead DevEx Engineer helping developers embrace to the agentic world. You may have seen him with a whiteboard breaking down web development and agentic coding concepts. You also may know him from Warp Factories, or as a core maintainer of Astro.build. If you're interested in becoming a factory foreman, go talk to him.

sessions.title: Your agent needs a skill to improve its skills
